reviews.review: The best in it's own genre

Games pretty good. Worth a buy at around 10-15 bucks.

Pros: 
The music tracks have some bangers
I like the puzzles and bosses, they are solid across the board
Classes and customization seems solid
The game is RNG based but all the options are so good that the RNG rarely ruins a run

Cons:
Game is honestly very easy, I beat the hardest difficulty solo after about 10 hours, so about 15-20 runs. 
Most weapons have pretty weak sound design, they need to be way beefier. 
The movement is pretty meh. There isn't many thing that can give you a lot of momentum, you just get flat % movement speed increases. This is by design for balance but it means that rocket jumping or bunny hopping or any attempt at movement tech hits a hard cap very quickly. As a result some of the best builds I've come across are those that use heavy weapons and you just barely move while melting crowds and bosses. 

All in all I'd say the game is a 7/10, almost 8/10 if you're having a really good run. Could be 9/10 with better sound design and more refined bosses and levels but the devs said they are done with the game so fair enough. It doesn't get anywhere near replacing doom eternal imo but if you like these kinds of games you can have fun with a friend in this one for sure.

This is a very well done game. Essentially it is a friendlier and funnier first-person version of Synthetic.

This is one of the best games I’ve ever played, and I’ve played a lot of games across different genres. While playing, I had a bittersweet thought that really reflects the amount of effort poured into this game: “It’s such a shame that one day I’ll finish it and the content will run out.” I’ve already spent 30 hours in the game and I have no intention of stopping anytime soon.

I think this game has insane potential, the developers have found the perfect formula for how all the gameplay elements work together. The music perfectly supports the game’s pace and even accelerates it; at some point, you just want to rush forward and destroy everything around you, regardless of your health bar.

This game is pure genius, everything in it is brilliant, from the art design (which will never go out of style) to every other aspect of the game.

Developers, please release DLC, at least six of my friends and I will definitely buy it. You've managed to create something near-perfect within this genre. Your game is the best on the market when it comes to first-person roguelike shooters.

I think you should definitely keep making games like this — it’s something that could make you very successful. Consider doing reskins of the game in different styles and settings, and expand the game outward, adding more variety and breadth.

I believe what you really need right now is better marketing for a project like this. The current concept is hard to sell in the market because, as a genre, it doesn’t look immediately appealing or commercially attractive. But that can be changed with great trailers and cinematic videos.

Right now, it feels like the game wins players over purely with its gameplay — and honestly, that’s the most important thing.

My brother and I finished the game, and for the past two days we’ve been talking about how amazing it i, we’re even spreading the hype and getting other people excited to try it too.
